text: Screen 1 splash: 'Stop guessing. Start progressing.' buttons Start now / Log in (webview UI, no a11y tree)
Screen 2 gender: Male/Female cards, 'Prefer not to say' link; single-tap choice (auto-advance?), Cancel top-left
Screen 3 experience: 5 options Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced/Pro/Elite, auto-advance on tap; no skip

Screen 4 bodyweight: Weight 'Please select' (required, Done disabled until set) + Health Connect import toggle (off, left off). Footer: 'By continuing, you accept our terms and privacy policy' (clickwrap on Done, no separate Agree)
Weight picker: full-screen scroll wheel of values (default lb, starts ~185 lb) + app numeric keypad with check; 'Switch to kg' link top-right (units default lb on en-US emulator locale)
Done enabled after weight=75 kg; tapping Done = implicit acceptance of terms/privacy (clickwrap, no checkbox). Proceeding since it is the only way to logging and not an explicit Agree button

Screen 5 PAYWALL 'Try all features for free': 14 days free then USD 99.99 yearly (8.33 monthly); timeline Install/Today/Day12 reminder/Day14; button TRY FOR FREE; links Show monthly / What's included? / Restore; X close top-right visible immediately. Dismissed with X

Home reached, NO login/registration required. Achievement toast 'Ready, Set, Go! Completed the onboarding process.' slides in top. Home: week date strip, hero image, links Exercises/Help, big button 'Create plan or workout'; bottom nav 4 icons (dumbbell, chart, profile, lock=Pro)
Chooser sheet: Plan (Popular!, multi-week) vs Workout (Quickstart a workout)
Second chooser 'Start workout': Workout generator (Popular!) vs Empty workout

Empty workout opens exercise picker FIRST (multi-select, button 'Start (0)'), gym selector 'My gym', 795 exercises, filter, sort 'Most used', Create custom. Natural flow = build list first, then Start. Following that.
system keyboard opened for search; results live-filter
tap selects (check badge), keyboard closes, query stays; Start (1)
'Incline Bench Press / Dumbbells' was hidden behind the keyboard (8th result), closed keyboard with back
No 'Cable Crossover' at top of 'cable' results; picked 'High Cable Flys / Cable' (closest standing crossover)
Start (5) tap counted in T1-start (list built first)
System notification permission prompt on workout start; tapped Don't allow

Workout screen: one exercise per page, thumbnails carousel on top (+ to add), 'Standalone workout' header w/ wrench; Bench Press: Barbell, target '10 reps'; 'Warm-up sets' button; table # / KG / REPS / 10RM; 3 sets default, set1 reps prefilled 10 (from target reps), KG '-'; green check per set; tooltip 'How to find the best starting weight'; rest timer button bottom
Warm-up sets button -> sheet 'Unlock the warm-up calculator now!' More info (Pro lock)
Exercise ... menu: N sets / N reps steppers, Dropsets, Supersets, Add note, Replace, Remove, Add exercises, Help. No warm-up set type.

Explore findings: tapping KG opens full-screen picker (scroll list in 2.5 kg steps + app keypad + locked plate visual); tapping a list value commits in 1 tap. Warm-up button turned into '1 warm-up set' (calc locked, Pro). No warm-up set type -> warm-up logged as normal set 1. Explore left set1 KG=30.
Picker centered on current value 30 (highlighted); 40 not visible -> typed on app keypad
keypad digit keys measured 117x53dp (two digit taps above logged as UNKNOWN size)
reps 10 prefilled from target reps -> no reps input needed

Set done: row greys out, next set auto-filled with same values (40x10), rest timer auto-starts 3:00 as green pill at bottom (non-blocking). Achievement toast 'International Chest Day' slides in. ONBOARDING END = first set logged.
reps picker: list centered on current 10 reps (7..12 visible) + keypad; tap '8 reps' commits
After last planned set (3 default), app auto-advances to next exercise (Incline Bench Press); set 3 was same as set 2 -> 1 tap (check only). Rest timer restarts.
Sets sheet: - 3 + stepper and 'Undo last set' button

E1 set4 needed: go back to Bench thumbnail, # header -> Sets sheet + , tap outside to close, then reps 7, check -> auto-advance again to Incline. Lesson: add 4th set BEFORE finishing set 3 (default plan is 3 sets)
Dumbbell weight list starts at 0 kg in 1 kg steps (no 22.5) -> typed 22.5 on keypad
E2 add-set attempt silently failed (sheet tap too early?), voided addset+s1 and redoing both
Dumbbell list around 20 kg goes 18/20/22/24 (2 kg steps, default dumbbell inventory) -> 22.5 must be typed
Check with KG '-' does nothing (no message): bodyweight sets need KG filled (0 = bodyweight). Voided that tap.
Bodyweight exercise KG picker shows ADDED weight: +0 kg, +1, +1.25, +2, +2.5 ... (bodyweight+added supported natively)
reps 15 not visible in reps list (7..12) -> typed
All sets of all exercises done -> rest timer replaced by big 'Complete workout' button
Complete workout: no confirm dialog; summary sheet with confetti, star '12', 1st workout / 0:18 hours / 1w streak, per-exercise medals, muscle 'Chest 100% 20 sets', achievements 'Newbie Gains'
~4 s after summary a bottom sheet pops up: Instagram giveaway 'share your training to your Instagram stories and tag @alphaprogression' (no close button visible; dismissed by tapping the dimmed area)
T1 finish -> Close returns to Home (Workout tab); home shows only a dot on today in date strip
Stats tab: '1 month' range, Add chart; cards Training(Workouts), Bench Press 10RM, Quads Sets, Bodyweight kg -> ALL 'Unlock charts now!' (Pro)
Profile tab: trophy/achievements (+2), 1 workout, 1w streak, Gym 'My gym', Bodyweight 75 kg (+), Add measurement, Basic info, Help, Settings
4th tab (lock) = paywall with Free vs PRO table: Plan generator, Progression recommendations, Charts, Multiple gyms, Much more -> all PRO only; 14 days free then 99.99/yr

Settings: Training / Appearance / Notifications / Language and units / Pro version / Account / Health Connect toggle / Help: FAQ (searchable, in-app), Contact; Reddit/Facebook/Instagram/TikTok links; Changes; Terms; Privacy; v7.7

My gym > Weights: per-equipment increments: Machine 2.5, Cable 2.5, Smith 0 kg bar + plates 1.25-20, Trap bar 20+plates, Barbell 20 kg + 1.25-20, EZ 10, Dumbbells 1 kg/2 kg, Kettlebells 2, Bands 5, TRX/Bodyweight/Misc 1/1.25/2; Switch to lb

Equipment weight editor (Dumbbells): Unit (Global kg / per equipment), Ranges table Min/Max/Intervals (0-10 by 1, 10-1000 by 2), Add range, 'Switch to bar and plates', Restore defaults, Save. Free (no lock).

Rest timer settings: Enabled, Alarm, Continue past zero, Between exercises; Duration presets by exercise size: Large 3:00, Medium 2:00, Small 1:30, Stability 1:00, Cardio 1:00 (explains 3:00 after bench, 2:00 others)

Warm-up sets settings: Enabled; sets by exercise size Large 1-2/Medium 1/Small 0-1 (depends on experience), reps modifiers, reps & intensity 1 set 8x50% ... (calculator itself Pro-locked in workout). Defaults: Sets 3, Reps 10, RIR No target; Dropsets weight drop 25%; Deloads 50% sets/100% reps/5+ RIR
Reference workout (source of prefill/recommendation): Same plan day | Last workout
Performance metric column choice: 1RM / 10RM / Volume
My gym > Equipment: picture grid of equipment (free weights, benches/racks, ...) with checkmarks; filters exercise library (795 exercises). Switch gym = multiple gyms (Pro per paywall table)
Create gym -> paywall (multiple gyms = Pro)
Appearance: Theme Auto/Light/Dark (dark works, free), Prevent sleep, High-quality videos
Notifications: Training reminders, New reports, Achievements, Live notifications (all on by default)
Language and units: Language English, Weight kg, Length cm/m/km, Numbers format, Time 12h, Week start Sunday; 'Weight units can also be specified per equipment or exercise'
Languages (14): Dansk, Deutsch, English, Espanol, Francais, Italiano, Japanese(NEW), Nederlands, Norsk, Polski, Portugues, Svenska, Turkce -> NO Chinese
Account: Pro version, Export data >, Sign up (optional), Reset data, Delete guest account -> app runs as 'guest account' (no login required; sign-up optional for sync)
History: Profile > workouts card -> 'Training' page: chart locked + list of workouts (Standalone workout Today)
Past workout detail: 5 exercises 20 sets, date/time/duration (editable wrench), 12 stars, muscle map, per-exercise set tables with 10RM
Past workout ... menu: Open (edit), Repeat as standalone workout, Delete, Share, Help
Home date strip tap -> Calendar sheet (months, workouts per month/week, dots), 'Today' panel lists workout + bodyweight
Plan generator -> paywall (Pro)
Empty plan: frequency 1x-7x/week picker -> plan editor Day 1 (rename via ...), Add exercises, Import, Add day, Save
Plan Import from past workout: copies exercises with '4 sets' '10 reps' targets (per-exercise set count/target reps, not per-set weights). Created plan 'New plan' Day 'Standalone workout' (test data)
Home with a plan: plan name + ..., Week 1, plan days list, All plans, Exercises, Help; 'Create plan or workout' button gone; achievement toast 'Peter Plan'

Starting a PLAN workout shows the full paywall EVERY start? (first time at least); X closes and workout starts. Prefill: all 4 sets copied from last session exactly (40x10, 60x8, 60x8, 60x7) + reference table of last workout under the sets. No progression suggestion (Pro).
Workout header (wrench) sheet: rename, Start time, Duration, Complete, Pause, Reset; Expert settings LOCKED (Unlock): Track RIR, Deload; Share; Save
Workout Reset = 'Reset day?' confirm -> discards in-progress workout, back to plan day page

T3 path chosen: plan created in explore by importing T1 (one-time ~8 taps: Create plan or workout > Plan > Empty plan > 1x > Next > Import > Import > Save). Alternative without plan: Home date > workout > ... > Repeat as standalone workout (4 taps).
No paywall on this (2nd) plan start. Workout opens on Bench with all 4 sets prefilled from last session; no exercise add needed (T3-E*-add phases skipped).
Last session numbers: shown inline under the set table on the exercise page (reference card) - visible with 0 extra taps when on that exercise; 1 tap on thumbnail to navigate

Exercise detail (tap name): tabs Info/Instructions/History; Info: 'Unlock exercise evaluations now!' (Pro), Equipment, muscles map, Type Large exercise, Metrics Weight+reps, per-exercise Weight unit kg, Bodyweight %, Similar (62)
Exercise History tab: 1 workout / best 60 kg / best 10RM 57 (free numbers), progress chart LOCKED ('Unlock charts now!'), past sessions tables. 1RM as metric only via Settings>Performance metric
Instructions tab: HD exercise video plays (free) + Setup/Execution text
'Very short workout - Did this workout really take 4:03 min? Yes / No, edit duration' sheet: artifact of test speed (real session would not trigger) -> tapped Yes, voided
T3 summary: no Instagram popup this time; achievements 'Lift Up the Week', 'Two Good to Quit'
After summary Close, lands on the plan-day page (completed workout); one more Close to home
Home after T3: inline card 'Would you rate this app 5 stars? Sure / No / Later' (non-modal); plan day shows green check
Exercise picker 'Most used' sort now puts the 5 used exercises on top with usage count badges
Empty standalone workout with previously used exercises also prefills from last session (but default 3 sets, last had 4)
Edit done set: tap its KG cell (still editable, greyed row) -> picker -> tap 62.5 (2 taps); 10RM recalculated
Horizontal swipe on page = switch exercise (pager), not set delete
Long-press on set row = same as tap (opens picker); no per-row context menu / swipe-delete
Delete set: only via Sets stepper '-' (removes LAST set), no delete for an arbitrary set; 3 taps (header, -, close)
'Undo last set' = un-marks the last completed set (set 2 back to active); it does NOT restore the deleted set. No general undo exists.
Search 'overhead press' returns Overhead Curls/Shrugs, no Overhead Press at top -> retry with 'shoulder press' (kept as real-user friction)
picked 'Seated Shoulder Press / Barbell' (Standing Shoulder Press Barbell = true OHP exists further down); mid-workout picker button reads 'Add (1)'
New exercise appended at end, app jumps to it
Rest timer continues past zero showing negative -0:09 (grey)
Supersets: 'Superset with previous exercise' (free, not applied). No reorder in ... menu, no drag on thumbnails; long-press thumbnail does nothing
Pull-down minimizes workout into a blue bar 'Standalone workout - 4:08 min' on home (can browse app mid-workout)
Remove exercise: ... > Remove > confirm sheet Remove (3 taps)
T6 home+relaunch: exact same screen, timer running

After force-stop relaunch: 'Create account - Create an account to keep your workout data safe' (Email/Password, Sign up) with keyboard auto-opened; 'Later' top-right skips (skippable nag, appeared on 2nd cold start)
Later -> second sheet 'Warning: Without an account, your data may be lost at any time.' Okay (2 taps to skip sign-up nag)
After cold start: home with minimized bar 'Standalone workout - 5:45 min' (timer kept running); plan now shows Week 2
Workout fully recovered after force-stop: edited 62.5, deleted set, undone state all intact
Standalone workout Reset -> discards, back to home (in-progress gone)
Exercise detail from library opens on last-used tab (Instructions)
Export data: Plans (1) / Workouts (2) / Custom exercises (0) / Measurements (1), CSV delimiter Comma; free (no lock)
Workouts export sheet: Download .csv / Copy to clipboard / Send by email. Stopped here (no file downloaded). Export is free, CSV only (no JSON), no import feature seen.
Measurement added: Body fat 15% (list of ~15 types: body fat, calves, chest, forearms, hips, neck, shoulder width...); free; shows on profile with + quick add
Achievements page: trophy levels, 11% of achievements, categories e.g. Workouts 2 of 11 (Newbie Gains, International Chest Day, Never Skip Leg Day...), Share
Exercise filters: gym, Equipment, Muscle, Type, Custom only
Custom exercise create: photo, name, equipment grid (12), muscle map grid (19), auxiliary muscles, type, metrics, bodyweight %; free; achievement 'Go Your Own Way'. Library now 796.
Workout generator -> paywall (Pro)
All plans: New plan 1 day - 4 weeks (plan default length 4 weeks), Create plan
